title: ID0445634-DC/Si-D/HU- [MP / S3 170003423] Power Module Error
description:
Reported behavior/issue: Seems module 2 has some perrors (E10 & E9). Please check it
remotely. Users reported that they were able to charger only
significantly less power on this charger, compared to other Sicharge
D chargers (same location). In this case it was something like less
then 60kW (current was limited to 84-85A) on both plugs. Other
charger was charging with 200A+ (same location, same type, 2
mins later. Car: EV6.
Attached the error messages during the charging. Issue was in
Friday, around 14:00-15:00 pm (Hungarian time).
Notes: No errors present in the charger (27/08), power modules recovered from the error

additional_info.body:
Hi Norbert,
Sorry for the delay as we had a surge of tickets.
I checked the charger and it seems that only these 3 converters are affected:
I would start by replacing one of them and trying a new charging session. If it works, then please replace the other converters.
The instructions for these errors is that it's not supposed to be replaced but I don't see how we can troubleshoot inside the converter.
I will send this to the RC-HU queue, please do the replacements as I mentioned.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
